g.text: pipeline/anomalies.py runs an Isolation Forest (scikit-learn, 300 trees, contamination 2%, seed 7) over the 540
buyers with at least 100,000 t retired since 2020. Features: share of pre-2016 vintages, share of ICVCM-rejected
methodologies, share in project types without a research estimate, largest single-year share, likely-real share of
researched tonnes, and average retirement size (log). A flag is shown only with readable reasons: a feature is
named when it is in the top 5% of the population (bottom 5% for likely-real share). Result: 8 buyers flagged. An
unusual pattern is a reason to look closer, never proof of wrongdoing.
